mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4.0% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a contraction in consumer demand, triggering negative sentiment and lower equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During high unemployment (UNRATE > 7.5%) with declining labor force participation (PAYEMS growth < 0.1% monthly), labor market weakness signals reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or Rank IC for regime-specific signal falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 850,000 units, it signals a contraction in the housing sector and reduced consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered periods, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 1-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and GDP (GDPC1) indicates a contraction in the real economy, triggering negative sentiment and lower equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in INDPRO and GDPC1 fails to produce negative 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC for interaction term remains below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During high inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 3.5%), the central bank is expected to tighten monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 3.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year rolling windows.
